clips.title: The story
paras: In Tinker Town, gnomes make a home in exile beneath Ironforge. After Gnomeregan fell, the district became the seat of High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque's government and the Ironforge terminus of the Deeprun Tram.

Tinker Town shelters the gnomes who fled Gnomeregan. When troggs overran their high-tech city, Ironforge's dwarves opened their gates, setting aside a cavern that had housed dwarves and held the Deeprun Tram entrance. High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque and his council lead the refugees here. Around a massive spherical contraption, the gnomes have rebuilt a semblance of their civilization amid whirring gears, experimental alchemy, and gadgetry. Though cramped guests in a stone city, they remain determined to reclaim their subterranean homeland.
Tinker Town connects Ironforge to Stormwind by tram. The district holds the Ironforge entrance to the Deeprun Tram, an engineering wonder that swiftly links the dwarven capital with Stormwind.
